address.title: Home address
address.description: Where the person lives. Street, city and state is enough. Leave empty if you give latitude and longitude instead.

radius_mi.title: Search radius (miles)
radius_mi.description: Most people with dementia who wander are found within 1.5 miles of where they went missing.

familiar_places.title: Familiar places
familiar_places.description: Places from the person's past they may head for: an old job, a church, a childhood street. Each item is {name, lat, lng}.

google_maps.title: Find places open at night (Google Maps Scraper)
google_maps.description: Also call Apify's Google Maps Scraper for 24-hour gas stations, stores, diners, ER, pharmacy and transit, with phone numbers and hours. Adds a few cents per run.

max_per_search.title: Max places per search term
max_per_search.description: Cap per search term (six terms) to control cost.

lat.title: Home latitude (optional)
lat.description: Use instead of the address for an exact point.

lng.title: Home longitude (optional)
lng.description: Use instead of the address for an exact point.
